info.description: Pipedrive's own v1 description (https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1), cut to three operations. Two changes by KIFF, stated here: each operation's security is the API token in the x-api-token header (Pipedrive accepts it there and lists a query parameter in this file), and the one write is narrowed to a note's words and the lead it is on.
info.title: Pipedrive API v1

get.description: Returns multiple not archived leads. Leads are sorted by the time they were created, from oldest to newest. Pagination can be controlled using `limit` and `start` query parameters. If a lead contains custom fields, the fields' values will be included in the response in the same format as with the `Deals` endpoints. If a custom field's value hasn't been set for the lead, it won't appear in the response. Please note that leads do not have a separate set of custom fields, instead they inherit the custom fields' structure from deals.

parameters.description: For pagination, the limit of entries to be returned. If not provided, 100 items will be returned.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: For pagination, the position that represents the first result for the page
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given user will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `owner_id` when supplied.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given person will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `person_id` when supplied.
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only leads matching the given organization will be returned. However, `filter_id` takes precedence over `organization_id` when supplied.
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.description: The ID of the filter to use
parameters.name: filter_id

parameters.description: If set, only leads with an `update_time` later than or equal to this time are returned. In ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2025-01-01T10:20:00Z.
parameters.name: updated_since

parameters.description: The field names and sorting mode separated by a comma (`field_name_1 ASC`, `field_name_2 DESC`). Only first-level field keys are supported (no nested keys). Supported fields: id, title, owner_id, creator_id, label_ids, value, source_name, was_seen, expected_close_date, next_activity_id, add_time, update_time, visible_to, and custom fields.
parameters.name: sort

additional_data.description: The additional data of the list

more_items_in_collection.description: If there are more list items in the collection than displayed or not

add_time.description: The date and time of when the lead was created. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

archive_reason.description: The reason for archiving the lead. Automatically cleared when the lead is unarchived.

cc_email.description: The BCC email of the lead

channel.description: The ID of your Marketing channel this Lead was created from. Recognized Marketing channels can be configured in your Company settings.

channel_id.description: The optional ID to further distinguish the Marketing channel.

creator_id.description: The ID of the user who created the lead

expected_close_date.description: The date of when the deal which will be created from the lead is expected to be closed. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: The unique ID of the lead in the UUID format

is_archived.description: A flag indicating whether the lead is archived or not

label_ids.description: The IDs of the lead labels which are associated with the lead

next_activity_id.description: The ID of the next activity associated with the lead

organization_id.description: The ID of an organization which this lead is linked to

origin.description: The way this Lead was created. `origin` field is set by Pipedrive when Lead is created and cannot be changed.

origin_id.description: The optional ID to further distinguish the origin of the lead - e.g. Which API integration created this Lead.

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the lead

person_id.description: The ID of a person which this lead is linked to

source_deal_id.description: The ID of the deal if the lead was converted from a deal.

source_name.description: Defines where the lead comes from. Will be `API` if the lead was created through the Public API and will be `Manually created` if the lead was created manually through the UI.

update_time.description: The date and time of when the lead was last updated. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

value.description: The potential value of the lead represented by a JSON object: `{ "amount": 200, "currency": "EUR" }`. Both amount and currency are required.

visible_to.description:
The visibility of the lead. If omitted, the visibility will be set to the default visibility setting of this item type for the authorized user.
ValueDescription
`1`Owner & followers (private)
`3`Entire company (shared)

was_seen.description: A flag indicating whether the lead was seen by someone in the Pipedrive UI
